title: 电容旁边并一个电阻：戴维宁求 τ
summary: 在 RC 电路的电容两端再并一个 10 kΩ：终值和时间常数都变了。用戴维宁等效电阻预测，再用示波器读数反算 τ。
concepts: Thevenin resistance 戴维宁等效电阻
τ from VH / VL 由读数反算 τ
description: 信号发生器（方波 0 ↔ 5 V）→ R1（10 kΩ）→ 结点 VC；VC 到 GND 之间并联 C1（100 nF）和 R2（10 kΩ）。CH1 看输入，CH2 看 VC。

cards.title: 给电容并一个电阻
text: - 板上已经是上一个 RC 电路。在电容两端再并一个 **R2 `10 kΩ`**：**`d10`** → GND 轨。
- 信号发生器还是 0 ↔ 5 V 方波。先用 **`100 Hz`** 看 CH2 的最高点，再换 **`1 kHz`**。
和没有 R2 时比：电容最后充到哪里？曲线是变快了还是变慢了？

cards.title: 从电容往外看：戴维宁
text: - 电容只“看见”它两端外面的电路。把外面化成**戴维宁等效**（2.4）：一个电压源串一个电阻。
- **终点**：电容充满后不再取电流，R1 和 R2 分压，所以不再是 5 V。
- **快慢**：把电源置零，从电容两端看进去，R1 和 R2 是**并联**的：
![](fig:req)
- 每个半周期仍是一条指数曲线：从上一个半周期结束的位置出发，朝新的终点走，速度由 τ 决定。
![](fig:swing)

cards.title: 用两个读数反算 τ
text: - **`100 Hz`** 时读 VC 的最高值：每半个周期都走到了终点，这就是终值。
- **`1 kHz`** 时读 VC 的最高值 VH 和最低值 VL。
- 放电的半个周期里，VC 从 VH 按指数往 0 走，走了 T/2 正好到 VL：VL = VH·e^(−T/2τ)。所以 τ = (T/2) / ln(VH / VL)。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **三要素**：v(t) = v(∞) + [v(0+) − v(∞)]·e^(−t/τ)。一阶电路的响应都长这样：起点、终点、τ。
- **τ = R_eq·C**：R_eq 是电源置零后，从电容两端看进去的电阻。
- 用 VH、VL 反算 τ 不需要知道终值，任何频率都能用。
- **真实电路里**：电容误差大（±10%～±20%）。用读数反算 τ，再除以 R_eq，就测出了电容的实际值。

caption.text: 电源置零（信号发生器那端接地）：从电容两端看进去，R1 和 R2 并联，就是 R_eq。

i18n.en: Source set to zero (the generator end goes to ground): seen from the capacitor's ends, R1 and R2 are in parallel — that is R_eq.

caption.text: 1 kHz 时的 VC：每个半周期都是一段指数曲线，在 VH 和 VL 之间来回。放电那一段从 VH 走 T/2 到 VL。

i18n.en: VC at 1 kHz: every half period is a piece of exponential, swinging between VH and VL. The falling piece goes from VH to VL in T/2.

en.title: A resistor across the capacitor: τ from Thevenin
en.summary: Put another 10 kΩ across the capacitor of an RC circuit: both the final value and the time constant change. Predict them with the Thevenin resistance, then work τ back from scope readings.
concepts: initial value, final value, time constant
en.description: Generator (square 0 ↔ 5 V) → R1 (10 kΩ) → node VC; between VC and GND, C1 (100 nF) in parallel with R2 (10 kΩ). CH1 on the input, CH2 on VC.
en.compare:
**Compare**:
- v(∞) = 5 V × 10 k / (10.05 k + 10 k) ≈ **2.49 V** — not 5 V! R_eq = 10.05 k ∥ 10 k ≈ 5.01 kΩ, τ ≈ **0.50 ms**, half of the plain series RC.
- **100 Hz** (half a period 5 ms ≈ 10τ): it reaches the end every time; VC between 0 and about 2.49 V.
- **1 kHz** (half a period 0.5 ms ≈ τ): VC between VL ≈ **0.67 V** and VH ≈ **1.82 V**; τ = 0.5 ms / ln(1.82 / 0.67) ≈ 0.50 ms.
- At 2 kHz VH ≈ 1.55 V and VL ≈ 0.94 V; the result is still about 0.50 ms.
hints: R2 is in parallel with C1: both have their legs in VC (column 10) and on the GND rail.
Final value: with the capacitor open, R1 (plus 50 Ω) and R2 form a divider.
τ = R_eq·C with R_eq = (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2; worked back, τ = (T/2) / ln(VH / VL).
tests: 100 Hz: every half period reaches its final value, discharging to ≈ 0
1 kHz: sensible VH and VL (τ set by R1 ∥ R2)

measurements.ask: 100 Hz: CH2 (VC) maximum, i.e. the final value v(∞)
measurements.explain: With the capacitor open, (R1 + 50 Ω) and R2 divide: 5 × 10 / 20.05 ≈ 2.49 V, not 5 V.
Half a period, 0.5 ms, ≈ τ: VC swings between VL and VH around v(∞) / 2 ≈ 1.25 V.

measurements.ask: From your readings, τ = (T/2) / ln(VH / VL) (T/2 = 0.5 ms)
measurements.explain: R_eq = 10.05 kΩ ∥ 10 kΩ ≈ 5.01 kΩ, τ = R_eq·C ≈ 0.50 ms: half of the plain series RC.

measurements.ask: Then with C = 100 nF, the resistance seen from the capacitor: R_eq = τ / C
measurements.explain: ≈ 5.0 kΩ = (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2: with the source zeroed, R1 and R2 are in parallel as the capacitor sees them.

cards.title: Put a resistor across the capacitor
text: - The last RC circuit is already on the board. Add **R2 `10 kΩ`** across the capacitor: **`d10`** → the GND rail.
- The generator is still a 0 ↔ 5 V square wave. Look at CH2's top at **`100 Hz`**, then switch to **`1 kHz`**.
Compared with no R2: where does the capacitor end up? Is the curve faster or slower?

cards.title: Looking out from the capacitor: Thevenin
text: - The capacitor only "sees" the circuit outside its two ends. Reduce that outside to its **Thevenin equivalent** (2.4): a source in series with a resistor.
- **The end point**: once full the capacitor draws no current, R1 and R2 divide the voltage, so it is no longer 5 V.
- **The pace**: set the source to zero and look in from the capacitor's ends: R1 and R2 are **in parallel**:
![](fig:req)
- Every half period is still one exponential: it starts where the last half ended and heads for the new end point, at a pace set by τ.
![](fig:swing)

cards.title: Work τ back from two readings
text: - At **`100 Hz`** read VC's maximum: every half period reaches the end point, so this is the final value.
- At **`1 kHz`** read VC's maximum VH and minimum VL.
- In the discharging half, VC heads from VH towards 0 along an exponential and after T/2 it is exactly at VL: VL = VH·e^(−T/2τ). So τ = (T/2) / ln(VH / VL).

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Three numbers**: v(t) = v(∞) + [v(0+) − v(∞)]·e^(−t/τ). Every first-order response looks like this: start, end, τ.
- **τ = R_eq·C**: R_eq is the resistance seen from the capacitor's ends with the source set to zero.
- Working τ back from VH and VL needs no final value and works at any frequency.
- **In a real circuit**: capacitors are loose (±10–20 %). Work τ back from readings, divide by R_eq, and you have measured the capacitor's real value.

tests.name: 100 Hz：每半周期都走到终值，放电到 ≈ 0
1 kHz：VH、VL 合理（τ 由 R1 ∥ R2 决定）

measurements.ask: 100 Hz：CH2（VC）的最高值，也就是终值 v(∞)

measurements.explain: 半个周期 0.5 ms ≈ τ，VC 在 VL 和 VH 之间来回，中心是 v(∞) / 2 ≈ 1.25 V。

measurements.ask: 用你的读数算 τ = (T/2) / ln(VH / VL)（T/2 = 0.5 ms）
measurements.explain: R_eq = 10.05 kΩ ∥ 10 kΩ ≈ 5.01 kΩ，τ = R_eq·C ≈ 0.50 ms：只有 RC 串联时的一半。

measurements.ask: 再用 C = 100 nF 算从电容看进去的等效电阻 R_eq = τ / C
measurements.explain: ≈ 5.0 kΩ = (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2：电源置零后，R1 和 R2 从电容看过去是并联的。

hints: R2 和 C1 并联：两只脚都在 VC（第 10 列）和 GND 轨上。
终值：电容开路后 R1（加 50 Ω）和 R2 分压。
τ = R_eq·C，R_eq = (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2；反算 τ = (T/2) / ln(VH / VL)。
